## Ctx.stopPoll() method

Stops a live poll, closing voting and returning the final results.

**Signature:**

```typescript
stopPoll(chatId?: number | Parameters<Context[`stopPoll`]>[0], messageId?: number | Parameters<Context[`stopPoll`]>[1], options?: Parameters<Ctx[`api`][`stopPoll`]>[2] | null): Promise<grammy_types.Poll>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;grammy\_types.Poll&gt;

The stopped poll with final vote counts.

## Remarks

Primary form `stopPoll(chatId, messageId, options?)` is a thin passthrough to `api.stopPoll` — no template involved. Use with a message previously sent by [Ctx.renderPoll()](./gramstax.ctx.renderpoll.md)<!-- -->. The inherited `Context.stopPoll(other?, signal?)` form still works and stops the poll in the current context.

why-not-base: base `Context.stopPoll` omits `chat_id`<!-- -->/`message_id` (current-context only); the explicit form targets any chat.

## Example


```typescript
async handleStopPoll() {
  await this.stopPoll(this.chat!.id, 42)
}
```
